title: Advance into a loop level
statement: For natural numbers $c,C,q$, a Boolean word $x$, a family of integer head positions $h$ indexed by the $c+1$ work tapes, an output word $o$, and a loop index $i$ among those tapes, one step of the unary generator from the configuration in advance state indexed by $i$ yields the configuration in loop state $i$ with head $i$ moved one cell to the right; all other head positions and the output are unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $h$ assigns an integer position to each of the $c+1$ work tapes
$i$ is a loop index among the $c+1$ work tapes
replaced:
For every loop level $i$, one step of the generator from the advance state
of level $i$ yields the loop state of level $i$ with head $i$ moved one cell
to the right, everything else being unchanged.
